name: venngage
description: Turn your content into professional, fully editable Venngage designs.

interface.longDescription:
Venngage turns your content into clear, professional designs you can fully edit. Share your notes, data, a long report or a training document, explain what you need, and Venngage condenses it into a polished infographic, one-pager, flyer, brochure and more. Venngage is a design platform that marketers, educators, students and businesses use to communicate information visually.

What you can make
Infographics, one-pagers, flyers, brochures, reports, proposals, presentations, posters, charts, timelines, process diagrams, social media graphics and more.

Why Venngage
- Fully editable: open your design in Venngage's drag-and-drop editor and adjust every element down to the pixel
- Built for clarity: Venngage specializes in turning dense information into clear, easy-to-scan visuals like one-pagers and infographics
- Built-in assets: stock photos, icons and charts
- On brand: apply your logo, colors and fonts with Brand Kit
- Accessible: check your design with the built-in accessibility checker and export an accessible PDF
- Ready to share: download as PNG or PDF, or share a link

Popular ways to use it
- Turn a long report or research findings into a one-page summary infographic
- Condense a training document or process guide into a step-by-step infographic
- Visualize survey results, stats or data
- Create a timeline for a project or product launch
- Design a brochure for a product, service or organization
- Build a one-pager for HR or internal company updates

Who it's for: anyone who needs to make something visual, including marketers, HR and internal comms teams, consultants, educators, students and small business owners.

How it works
1. Connect your Venngage account, or create one as you connect.
2. Share your content and explain what you need, like "turn this report into a one-page infographic."
3. Open the design in Venngage to edit, download or share. You can keep refining it with Venngage's AI there too.

Good to know: Each request creates a new design in your Venngage account. Changes are made inside Venngage, by hand or with Venngage's AI. Some features, like Brand Kit and certain downloads, depend on your Venngage plan.

positive.description: Statistical infographic from data in the prompt
positive.prompt: Make an infographic showing remote work stats: 58% work remotely at least once a week, 35% fully remote, 87% would take the option if offered
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new editable infographic in the user's Venngage account that uses all 3 stats, then returns the design title, a preview and a link to open it in the Venngage editor.

positive.prompt: Create a timeline infographic of our product launch: research in January, beta in March, launch in June
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a timeline infographic showing the 3 milestones in order, then returns the design title, a preview and an editor link.

positive.prompt: Create a brochure for a community food bank covering how to donate, volunteer and get help
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a brochure with sections for donating, volunteering and getting help, then returns the design title, a preview and an editor link.

positive.prompt: Design a brochure for a dental clinic covering services, our team and how to book
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a brochure with sections for services, the team and booking, then returns the design title, a preview and an editor link.

positive.description: Report design beyond infographics and brochures
positive.prompt: Create a one-page report summarizing Q3 sales results for a team meeting
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a one-page report design, then returns the design title, a preview and an editor link.

negative.description: General design question with no design requested. The app should not be called; ChatGPT answers in chat.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between a flyer and a brochure?

negative.description: Deleting designs is not supported. No tool should be called; ChatGPT explains the app can only create new designs and that designs can be deleted in Venngage.
negative.prompt: Delete all the designs in my Venngage account

negative.description: Editing an existing design is not supported. No tool should be called; ChatGPT suggests opening the design in the Venngage editor, or offers to create a new version.
negative.prompt: Change the headline on the brochure I made last week
